backups.title: Database backups

state.fresh: Newest backup is {{hours}} hours old (limit {{limit}} hours).
state.stale: Newest backup is {{hours}} hours old — older than the {{limit}} hour limit. The backup job is not producing dumps.
state.empty: No backups found in the bucket yet.
state.error: Could not read the backup bucket.
state.misconfigured: Backup freshness monitoring is configured incorrectly. Off-site backup health is unknown.
state.setupMissing: Backup freshness monitoring is enabled, but the off-site bucket is not configured yet.
state.unknown: No freshness check has run yet. The worker records one every 6 hours.

reason.futureTimestamp: The newest backup is dated in the future, so its age cannot be trusted. The clock on the machine that made it is probably wrong.

backups.docsHint: If backups are missing or out of date, ask whoever deploys this app to set them up — you cannot enable them from here.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Recent BullMQ failures across every production queue.
jobs.noneFailedDescription: The queues have no retained failed jobs. This page refreshes automatically while open.

overview.title: Admin overview
overview.description: Manage users, background jobs, backups, and settings.
overview.noPostsDescription: Create your first post from the Posts tab.

setupBanner.title: No administrator account yet
setupBanner.message: Nobody can become an admin on this deploy. Set <0>SETUP_KEY</0> and run <0>pnpm deploy:generate-admin</0> to create the first admin, or set <0>ADMIN_EMAILS</0>, then restart the server. See your deployment docs for details.
setupBanner.errorMessage: The app could not check whether administrators are configured. Review the server logs before publishing.

setupKeyBanner.title: Remove SETUP_KEY
setupKeyBanner.message: <0>SETUP_KEY</0> is still set on the server. It is only needed to create the first admin — remove it from the environment and redeploy.

settings.title: Admin Settings
settings.force2faInternalDescription: Required by default. Admin users must set up two-factor authentication before they can use internal tools; a newly created admin account has 24 hours to enroll before it loses access.
settings.force2faPublicDescription: When enabled, signed-in non-admin users must set up two-factor authentication before they can use the application.
settings.force2faAdminWarning: You must enable 2FA for your own account before you can require it for others. Go to Security settings to set it up.
settings.force2faInternalEnabled: Two-factor authentication is now required for administrators
settings.force2faInternalDisabled: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for administrators
settings.force2faPublicEnabled: Two-factor authentication is now required for public users
settings.force2faPublicDisabled: Two-factor authentication is no longer required for public users
settings.updateFailed: Couldn't update that setting. Try again.

twoFactorNudge.title: Two-factor authentication is not set up
twoFactorNudge.message: Your admin account signs in with a password alone. Add an authenticator app as a second factor so a stolen password can't unlock this dashboard.
twoFactorNudge.requiredTitle: Two-factor authentication is required for your admin account
twoFactorNudge.requiredMessage: Add an authenticator app as a second factor {{deadline}}. After that, this dashboard stays locked until you finish enrolling.
twoFactorNudge.blockedTitle: Admin access is locked until you set up two-factor authentication
twoFactorNudge.blockedMessage: Your enrollment window has closed, so admin actions are being refused. Set up an authenticator app now to get this dashboard back.
twoFactorNudge.configurable: An admin who has already enrolled can change this policy under Settings in the admin dashboard.

users.title: Users
users.description: Invite new members, change roles, archive accounts, or request deletion.
users.promoteDescription: {{name}} ({{email}}) will be able to manage users, roles, and app settings, and use the other admin features in this app.
users.demoteDescription: {{name}} ({{email}}) will lose access to the admin dashboard and its user, role, and app settings controls.
users.roleUpdateFailed: Couldn't update that role. Try again.

roleErrors.selfDemotion: You cannot remove your own admin role.
roleErrors.lastActiveAdmin: You cannot remove the last active admin. Make another verified, active user an admin first.
roleErrors.userNotFound: This user was not found. Refresh the list and try again.
roleErrors.conflict: Another user change happened at the same time. Review the users and try again.

users.archiveFailed: Couldn't archive that user. Try again.
users.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore that user. Try again.
users.deletionRequested: Deletion requested. Access has stopped; cleanup is pending.
users.deleteFailed: Couldn't request deletion for that user. Try again.
users.inviteDescription: Creates the account and emails the new user a one-time link to choose their own password. If the email can't be sent, you'll get the link to pass on yourself.
users.localeDescription: The invite and every later email use this language. They can change it in their settings.
users.inviteFailed: Couldn't create that invite. Try again.
users.resendFailed: Couldn't resend that invite. Try again.
users.inviteNotPending: This person has already started using their account or signs in another way, so there's no invite to resend.
users.revealDescription: The invite email couldn't be sent, so pass this link on yourself through a channel you trust. It lets them choose their password. They confirm their email address when they first sign in: we email them a link then.
users.setPasswordLinkHint: Shown only once. It works one time and expires {{date}}. Anyone with the link can claim this account, so don't post it anywhere public. If it's lost or expires, use Resend invite.
users.deleteDescription: This stops the user's access immediately and requests deletion; cleanup is pending. The plan is to remove private matches and retain published replays in anonymized form.
users.typeEmailToConfirm: Type the user's email to confirm

capacity.title: Hosted matches
capacity.description: Live load of the hosted match worker. Refreshes every few seconds.
capacity.noWorker: No worker reported in the last 15 seconds. Hosted matches won't start until one runs.
capacity.empty: No hosted matches are running or queued.
